name: Songea
source: Tanzania Ministry of Lands, Housing and Human Settlements Development e-Ardhi / GeoServer deployment; Songea parcel coverage not verified

queries.query: Songea Tanzania official cadastral map parcel GIS land registry
queries.result: Found the official Ministry land-rent portal, its e-Ardhi link, the official e-Ardhi application, an anonymous GeoServer WFS capability document exposing spatial-unit layers, and the official Songea Municipal Council site. No indexed Songea parcel download or city-specific public parcel endpoint was found.

queries.query: Songea Tanzania ramani ya cadastral ardhi kiwanja usajili
queries.result: Found official Swahili Ministry and Songea municipal material describing plot surveying, registration/formalization, and digital land services, but no public Songea parcel geometry or local cadastral feature service.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Tanzania Ministry of Lands, Housing and Human Settlements Development
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: National e-Ardhi application; city coverage not established
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Current application shell was retrieved. Its JavaScript configuration exposed SERVER_URL https://eardhi.lands.go.tz/gw, GRAPHQL_API https://eardhi.lands.go.tz/api, and GEOSERVER_API https://eardhi.lands.go.tz/map/geoserver/taspro.

officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Public service layer catalogue; not proven Songea coverage
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Anonymous HTTP 200 WFS capabilities returned spatial_units, survey_spatial_units, tp_spatial_units, regularization_scheme_parcels and related layers.

Official municipal site confirms the local council and advertises digital government services, but the retrieved content did not expose an anonymous parcel map, cadastral API, or downloadable parcel geometry.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Tanzania Property and Business Formalization Program
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official Swahili procedure says applications for surveying and title go through land offices at the relevant council; it is general procedure evidence, not Songea local registry evidence.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official Swahili land-rent portal loaded and linked users to e-Ardhi for regions including others beyond the examples. No parcel geometry was returned.
Current JavaScript application shell loaded. Configuration inspection identified the public GeoServer base; no login or credentials were used.
Anonymous WFS capabilities response returned. It advertised spatial_units and related parcel/spatial-unit layers.

Schema response declared native integer id, native string uid, and MultiPolygon geom, alongside many source attributes. Only id, uid, and geom were requested in subsequent probes; no unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Bounded Songea-area bbox [35.60,-10.72,35.69,-10.62] in EPSG:4326, count=3, propertyName=id,uid,geom. No response bytes were received.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET with WFS GetFeature exact-point neighborhood
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Bounded bbox [35.6429,-10.6705,35.6438,-10.6695] in EPSG:4326, count=1, propertyName=id,uid,geom. No response bytes were received. The WUP point was not shifted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official national e-Ardhi application and anonymous GeoServer layer catalogue only.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Capabilities and schema are public; Songea feature coverage and responsive parcel query are unverified.
coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: No Songea local registry/cadastre custodian or local parcel procedure endpoint was independently evidenced; general national procedure and municipal-government evidence only.

qualityAssessment.geometryQuality: No geometry retained because both bounded Songea feature requests timed out.
qualityAssessment.crs: WFS request used EPSG:4326 and the service schema declared MultiPolygon geometry; a successful Songea feature response was not obtained.
qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: Potential native identities are id and uid per DescribeFeatureType, but semantics were not independently verified from a Songea feature.
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: Only id, uid, and geom were requested in parcel probes. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, or document fields were requested or retained.

blocker: Serial review must independently qualify Songea coverage, a responsive anonymous parcel query, native identity semantics, CRS/axis handling, and geometry quality before runtime use.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [-10.6700269346208,35.6433691225135] is preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide absence.
No retained GeoJSON sample because no safe Songea feature response was obtained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and is not source integration/admission.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception used.
identityPolicy: No GeoJSON was retained. If later obtained, retain exactly one stable native parcel identity in properties.id; keep native field mapping and composite-key provenance in city/service-review metadata.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should retry the official e-Ardhi GeoServer route, inspect current map configuration for Songea/council coverage, and independently validate a bounded response before considering adapter qualification.
